benchmarks.task_description: [fix] Install the Prisma CLI with production dependencies ### ✨ What’s Changed? The image build got past the OpenAI peer conflict and then failed in `postinstall`: ``` sh: prisma: not found npm error code 127 npm error command sh -c prisma generate ``` `.npmrc` sets `legacy-peer-deps=true`. With that, `npm ci --omit=dev` skips devDependencies, and the Prisma CLI was one of them. `postinstall` is `prisma generate`, and the API init container runs `npm run migrate` (`npx prisma migrate deploy`) from the same image. `prisma` is now a production dependency, still at `^5.22.0`. `Dockerfile.base` copies the Prisma schema before install so that image’s postinstall can generate too. ### 🔍 How to Review / Test - `npm ci --omit=dev` with `.npmrc` present runs `prisma generate` and leaves `prisma` 5.22.0 on `PATH`. - Production audit findings are unchanged (`follow-redirects`, `glob` / `minimatch`, `exceljs`). None come from the Prisma CLI. ### 📋 Checklist - [x] PR title starts with `[#issue-number]`; if no issue is applicable use: `[fix]`, `[feat]`, `[ops]`, or `[prod]` - [x] I’ve added/updated tests (or noted why they’re not needed) - [x] I’ve verified the change runs locally (and in Docker/k8s if relevant) - [ ] If this changes the API contract, I’ve called that out clearly (and considered backward compatibility) - [ ] If this includes a DB change, I’ve included a migration + rollout/rollback notes - [ ] I’ve considered observability (logs/metrics/traces) and added what’s needed - [ ] I’ve set labels, linked issue, and milestone (if applicable) No API or schema change. No new tests: this is which packages the production install includes. Docker is not available in this environment, so the full image build was not run here. ### 🛠 Related Issue Related to the Continuous Integration failure on main after #1476.

`list-prs-for-branch` - Restore feature

Created by Claude, will be reviewed by @fregante first.

The commits page now uses a React branch button instead of `details#branch-select-menu`, so the feature found nothing to attach to. It now hooks into `branchSelector` and adds the PR link right after the button. Removes the unused `branchSelectorParent` and `addAfterBranchSelector`.

Fixes #9151

## Test URLs

https://github.com/refined-github/sandbox/commits/4679-1
https://github.com/refined-github/sandbox/commits/branch/with/slashes

## Checked

On the server-rendered markup of https://github.com/refined-github/sandbox/commits/4679-1, in Chromium with a build that had a token: `main` adds nothing, this branch adds the `#28` link as the next sibling of the branch button. `details#branch-select-menu` matched 0 elements on every `branchSelector_` test URL.

## Not checked (reviewer tasks)

- The layout. GitHub's CSS can't load in the sandbox, so I couldn't see the spacing. The link has `margin-right: auto` so that the filters on the right stay put, which needs a look logged in.
- https://github.com/refined-github/sandbox/commits/branch/with/slashes has no PR so it should show nothing.

Read the layout with comments erased: blank runs and unmarked span closers Refs markup-carve/carve#4728 (carve-js) Refs markup-carve/carve#4752 (carve-js) Implements the Expected sections of carve#4728 and carve#4752. One cause: both read a comment as something layout can see, where PART 0 S1 erases it first. ## carve#4728: the blank run around a comment `commentsBeforeSibling` reset its run at a comment line. It now counts every blank around the comments, so three end the list (PART 9 §11 N1a, CARVE-P9-014, carve#4660). Input: ```carve - a %% c - b ``` Before: ```html

  • a

  • b

``` After (the Expected output): ```html
  • a
  • b
``` ## carve#4752: an unmarked closer of a quoted span The closer searches now test the first line short of the quote's depth, and the quote collector keeps that line when it closes the innermost open span of that exact width. An unmarked line that is not the closer still ends the quote and leaves the span unclosed, as before. Row 888 is new to this engine's run: its category is added to `IMPLEMENTED`, so all six cases are compared. Row 888 case 1: ```carve > %%% > secret %%% ``` Before: ```html

secret

``` After: ```html
``` Row 888 case 2 (`-2`): ```carve > %%% > secret %%% > more ``` Before: ```html

secret

more

``` After: ```html

more

``` Rows `-3`, `-4` and `-5` (an indented closer, nested quotes) moved the same way and match their goldens; `-6` (no closer) did not change. `test/fixtures/corpus-render-ledger.txt` moved for those five rows only, regenerated with `npm run ledger:render`. ## Variant sweep 4,776 inputs. Span family: quote depth 1 to 3, width 3 or 4, closer width off by one, closer prefix depth, indent, tail, six followers, top level or in an item. Run family: four list kinds, four comment shapes, 0 to 3 blanks on each side, comment column, hosts top level, quote and nested item. 1,104 differed from the spec model before, 55 after. All 55 are the nested-item host, where a comment sits in a run of three or more. carve-js follows the text there ("AT EVERY LEVEL", "A comment between blank lines does not split the run"), and 20 of them agreed with the model before this PR only because the old code had the model's bug. Filed as markup-carve/carve#4760 with the Expected output. Timing (`parse`, mean of 2, machine load around 12 on 16 cores), closer / run / unclosed opener: 2k lines 41 / 53 / 15 ms, 8k 40 / 56 / 21 ms, 32k 181 / 204 / 182 ms. All linear. ## Local checks `npm run typecheck` is clean. 598 test files matching list, comment, quote, corpus, fence, conformance and roundtrip passed locally before the final rebase. The full local vitest run was refused by the machine's guard because another lane's full suite was running, so the complete suite is CI's. ## Codex review `codex review --base origin/main` (codex v0.166.0, gpt-6-sol; this machine's `codex` is the plain binary, so no codex-router account line is printed): "I found no actionable regressions in the diff. The new tests and corpus tests pass."

benchmarks.task_description:
fix: 殿堂入り画面のX（Twitter）ポスト文面を120文字以内に収まるよう短縮 (#96)

## 概要
本プルリクエストは、以下の2点を解決します。
1. **殿堂入り画面のX（Twitter）ポスト文面短縮 ([#96](https://github.com/meshi-z/turf-talk/issues/96))**
2. **GitHub Actions（Deploy to GitHub Pages）の `npm ci` 失敗の解消**

---

## 主な変更内容

### 1. シェア文面フォーマットのスリム化 (`src/lib/hallOfFame.ts`)
- 生成されるシェア文面を必須情報（世代・馬名・二つ名・戦績・習得数・ハッシュタグ・URL）に凝縮：
  ```text
  🏇 TurfTalk 殿堂入り
  第{generation}世代「{name}」【{titleName}】
  ```

### 2. GitHub Actions (`npm ci`) 失敗原因の解消 (`package.json`, `package-lock.json`)
- **失敗原因**:
  - PR #93（Issue #16）以降のコミットで `package.json` の `devDependencies`（`typescript` 等）が古いバージョン（`5.9.3`）に巻き戻り、`package-lock.json`（`7.0.2`）と不一致になっていたため、GitHub Actions の `npm ci` 実行時に `Invalid: lock file's typescript@7.0.2 does not satisfy typescript@5.9.3` エラーが発生していました。
- **解消対応**:
  - `package.json` の `devDependencies`（`typescript@~7.0.2`, `@types/react-dom@^19.2.7`, `@vitejs/plugin-react@^6.1.1`, `oxlint@^1.89.0`）を `package-lock.json` と完全再同期。
  - `npm ci --dry-run` にて整合性を検証完了。
